skills.name: audit-investment-thesis
skills.title: Audit investment thesis
skills.summary: Audit an investment opportunity against a firm's stated mandate and demonstrated historical decision behavior.
requirements: Access to opportunity materials and at least one source of firm investment criteria
Authorized access to historical deal records when behavioral calibration is requested

skills.name: financial-data-sourcing
skills.title: Financial data sourcing
skills.summary: Route financial data through authorized connectors first, then a logged-in browser session and local browser automation.
requirements: Authorized financial-data connector, logged-in provider browser session, or analyst-provided export

skills.name: roll-forward-portfolio-model
skills.title: Roll forward portfolio model
skills.summary: Roll forward an existing private equity portfolio company master model from the latest Excel financial report.
skills.examplePrompt: Roll forward the attached portfolio company master model using the attached latest monthly financial report. Preserve the model's existing structure, formulas, formatting, units, and sign conventions; add the new actual period, refresh trailing metrics, reconcile the results, and return the updated workbook with a concise audit report. Do not overwrite the original master.
requirements: Native .xlsx inspection, editing, recalculation, rendering, and export capability

skills.name: spread-trading-comps
skills.title: Spread trading comps
skills.summary: Build a sourced public-company trading comps workbook and indicative valuation range for a portfolio company or investment target.
requirements: Native .xlsx creation, recalculation, rendering, and export capability
Authorized access to public-company financial and market data or an analyst-provided export
